## 2. Core Architectural Competencies

### Enterprise Integration & Event-Driven Architecture
- Contract-first API design, OpenAPI 3.0 / JSON Schema governance, and backward compatibility enforcement.
- Event-driven choreography and orchestration using Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, and Azure Service Bus.
- Transactional outbox patterns, idempotent event consumers, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automated replay, and distributed saga workflows.
- Deep integration expertise across ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics), PIM, POS, payment gateways, and headless commerce engines (Shopify Plus, Kibo Commerce).

### Cloud & Distributed Platforms
- Production Microsoft Azure architecture: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, API Management (APIM), Azure Functions, CosmosDB, Azure Redis Cache.
- High-throughput API gateway policies, rate limiting, mutual TLS (mTLS), and zero-trust security with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect federation.
- Resilience patterns: Circuit breakers, adaptive timeouts, bulkhead isolation, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry and Application Insights.

### Operational Intelligence & AI Systems (ZaakiyV3RSE)
- Creator of **ZaakiyV3RSE**: an operational intelligence agentic platform that connects business signals to operational context.
- Combines source-of-truth routing, enterprise RAG, deterministic calculations, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM reasoning to verify business workflow delivery.

## 3. Selected Enterprise Case Studies

### 1. Enterprise Retail Integration
- **Domain:** Enterprise Retail & Omnichannel Commerce
- **Challenge:** Unifying catalog, inventory, pricing, and order workflows across 9 regional markets and heterogeneous ERP systems.
- **Architecture:** Event-driven integration fabric utilizing Azure Event Hubs, Redis cache tiers, and contract-governed microservices.
- **Outcome:** Reliable multi-market stock synchronization, near-zero inventory discrepancies, and continuous order processing during high-volume peak campaigns.
- **URL:** https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/enterprise-retail-integration

### 2. Airline Retailing & NDC Aggregation
- **Domain:** Travel Technology & Commercial Aviation
- **Challenge:** Aggregating multiple airline NDC suppliers with disparate response schemas, high latency, and frequent downstream timeouts.
- **Architecture:** Multi-threaded aggregation engine with speculative execution, circuit breaking, normalized travel schema cache, and asynchronous order fulfillment.
- **Outcome:** Sub-150ms search latency across multiple airline suppliers with unified booking workflows for B2B and B2C channels.
- **URL:** https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/airline-retailing-aggregation

### 3. Automotive Omnichannel Platform
- **Domain:** Automotive Retail & Fleet Operations
- **Challenge:** Fragmented customer journeys between showroom visits, online reservations, test-drive bookings, and workshop servicing.
- **Architecture:** Unified event spine syncing lead pipelines, vehicle inventory availability, and CRM workflows in real time.
- **URL:** https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/automotive-omnichannel-platform

### 4. Real Estate ERP Architecture
- **Domain:** Real Estate Operations & Asset Management
- **Challenge:** Multi-branch property management, lease agreements, tenant portals, payment reconciliation, and maintenance scheduling.
- **Architecture:** Modular multi-tenant ERP platform architected and delivered under accelerated engineering timelines.
- **URL:** https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/real-estate-erp-architecture

### 5. Zaakiy V3RSE Operational Intelligence Platform
- **Domain:** AI Platforms & Autonomous Workflow Reasoning
- **Challenge:** Traditional observability monitors uptime, but cannot reason about whether an end-to-end business transaction succeeded.
- **Architecture:** Multi-agent runtime with deterministic audit trails, context grounding, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
- **URL:** https://www.sanukhan.dev/projects/zaakiy-v3rse
